Managed IT services for everyday business technology

Valo supports the computers, accounts, cloud services, networks, and security controls used by small and midsize organizations.

Managed IT Support

Remote and on-site help for employee devices, business applications, printers, accounts, and day-to-day IT issues.

Cybersecurity

MFA, endpoint protection, email security, account policies, security awareness, and basic incident response planning.

Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 administration, user setup, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, licensing, and tenant cleanup.

Networks & Wi-Fi

Business firewalls, switches, wireless access points, guest networks, VPN access, and connectivity troubleshooting.

Backup & Recovery

Managed backups for servers, Microsoft 365 data, and workstations with restore checks and retention planning.

Computer Management

Device setup, patching, encryption, antivirus, software deployment, inventory, onboarding, and offboarding.
